note: Single source for HOW each long-lived data stream is stored across volume tiers. The backend is a CONFIG choice, not a code rewrite: a stream is written through src.teleon.storage.record_store (the one append-only port) and the tier decides the backend. Counts/backends here are read by code + the family/validate checks; never hand-mirror them in prose.
law: config-tier = whole-file git-tracked JSON (git IS the store — a DB would lose PR-review/history/diff for zero scale benefit); operational/history = append-only RecordStore with content-addressed idempotency, a durable JSONL mirror (single on-disk source) + a db-served read index; the cloud backend is a config swap (OH_STORAGE_MODE=cloud), never a caller change. serves_truth=false for every stream (a record is evidence, never a truth claim).

config.rationale: human-edited, PR-reviewed, diffable control-plane config (model lists, strategies, laws). Volume is bounded; git is the right database. Read whole-file, deterministic + offline.

operational.rationale: indexed lookups/joins/filters at request time; pgvector for embeddings. The current hot/active rows behind the product.

history.rationale: append-only, time/shard-partitioned columnar (BigQuery/ClickHouse) + object-store (Parquet) cold tier; content-addressed idempotency so dedupe is O(1) indexed, never an O(n) rescan; NEVER a single hot table. The materialized 'current' view is derived from the latest-by-key over this log.

streams.note: the descent BRAIN — every unbounded->bounded attempt incl. losers/failures (lossless training negatives). Grows without bound; the canonical trillion-row stream.
change-data-capture stream for governed facts (regulations/rates/prices) — revocation + re-sync history.
append-only component/module version log; 'current' = latest-by-(component_id) over this stream (version lives in metadata, never in the id).
staged candidate rows (the factory's daily output) before promotion; queried/filtered at runtime.
pgvector/vector-store rows; the cloud backend is postgres+pgvector (or a dedicated vector DB per db/vector/spec.md).

the multi-model executive review board — Claude/Kimi/GLM reviewing the code+PMF through CEO/COO/CTO/CFO/YC lenses + cross-critiquing each other. Append-only; every round/persona/model is a record. serves_truth=false (model opinions are candidates).
the model registry the descent selects against (a few dozen rows); stays JSON.
the per-axis descent strategy config; a handful of rows; stays JSON.
the Baltor->Teleon->OHH law; tiny, hand-curated, PR-gated; stays JSON.
